scope: Final development-01 tablet native stills; both iPad orientations, all five restoration stages, dense 49-piece boards, native clears/wins, rotation retention and terminal actions.
summary: Both bespoke layouts preserve rich connected mill, workshop, bridge, terraces and foreground construction without intruding on essential board pieces.
Restoration progresses through localized wheel, building and lamp repairs. In both orientations the outlet is closed at 75%; only 100% opens it and sends golden light through the downstream channels.
All 49 pieces remain readable in both dense boards. HUD, dialogue and terminal actions remain legible and contained.
No visible center-clearing mask, rectangular fade seam or abrupt cloud edge was found. The intentional whole-scene terminal dimming leaves the open outlet and golden payoff visible.

nonblockingObservations.finding: Landscape crops the extreme outer tip of the top wheel vane. The full wheel mechanism, identity and opening payoff remain understandable; this is an edge composition crop, not a gameplay obstruction.
Portrait score text crosses the upper wheel vane. Text stays legible and no gate or play piece is obscured.
The lower-left amber piece on the dense portrait board overlaps warm foliage. Its bright faceted silhouette remains distinct.

limitations: Visual review of original raw PNG bytes displayed with orientation metadata; no image edits or recompression.
Capture names containing normal-motion do not establish animation timing or fluidity. Stills only were reviewed.
No physical-device, actual VoiceOver or broader-device acceptance is claimed.
Source commit plus development build ID describe the working development capture, not clean published-commit acceptance.
The landscape 100% scene and final-result-action captures are byte-identical; each requested PNG was still inspected.
